## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Jul 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Cathy G_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Latest update has completely broken the app. Any interaction with the home screen causes it to shut down, then it won't reopen unless you force stop it. please fix!!"
            2. _Ubaidurrahman Ansari_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Using Samsung Health on S21 Ultra and F54 with same Samsung account. Before July update, sync worked perfectly and all walk, steps and water data became same on both devices. After update, sync shows successful but data stays separate. S21 Ultra walk does not appear on F54 and vice versa. Please fix this sync bug........This is the worst update so far. The previous interface was much easier to use, more user-friendly, and better than the current one."
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
